name: gizza-ai/egfr-calc
summary: Estimate kidney filtration rate (eGFR) from creatinine, age and sex using race-free CKD-EPI.

tool.description: Estimate glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) from serum creatinine, age and sex using the race-free CKD-EPI creatinine equations. Pass creatinine (with creatinine_unit=mg/dL or µmol/L), age (adults 18–120), sex (male/female), and optionally equation (ckd_epi_2021 default, the current US standard, or ckd_epi_2009 for comparison — its race coefficient is deliberately omitted). Every parameter is optional with a sensible default. Returns egfr in mL/min/1.73 m² (whole number), the KDIGO GFR category (gfr_stage G1–G5) with a plain-language stage_description, the creatinine used in mg/dL, and a summary. Informational estimate, not a diagnosis or medical advice.

age.description: Age in whole years. CKD-EPI is validated for adults, so ages under 18 are rejected. Default 50 (range 18–120).

creatinine.description: Serum creatinine value, in the unit given by creatinine_unit (mg/dL by default). Must be an IDMS-standardized lab value. Default 1.0.

creatinine_unit.description: Unit of the creatinine value: mg/dL (US) or µmol/L (SI, converted by ÷88.42). Default mg/dL.

equation.description: Which race-free CKD-EPI creatinine equation to use: ckd_epi_2021 (default, the current NKF/ASN-recommended US standard) or ckd_epi_2009 (older, for historical comparison; the 2009 race coefficient is deliberately omitted).

sex.description: Biological sex used by the equation: male or female. Default male.
